title: 2024 Fleer Retro Looney Tunes Skybox Trading Card #75 WHICH WITCH IS WHICH
descriptionText: The product is a 2024 Fleer Retro Looney Tunes Skybox Trading Card featuring the character Witch Hazel from the Looney Tunes franchise. This non-sport trading card is part of the retro set and showcases the iconic characters from the Looney Toons TV show. Manufactured by Fleer, this card is a must-have for collectors of Trading Card Singles, especially those interested in vintage Looney Tunes memorabilia.
